title: Google is killing authentic websites & I made it worse 😔 Here's why I RUINED my company website
summary: Louis Rossmann explains how Google delisted his repair business site for almost a year, and how having AI rewrite his authentic content into corporate-style text finally restored his rankings.
why: HN cites it as a firsthand example of search engines rewarding AI-flavored content over genuine writing.
topic: google search ranking and ai content

quote.text: where he had Gemini replace his 10+ year carefully curated content with AI slop and he instantly shot (back) up to the top of the rankings.
